keep_features.feature_value: Uses a strong profanity to attack a named politician
keep_features.rationale: The post contains explicit taboo/profane language directed at an identifiable public figure.

keep_features.feature_value: Insulting profanity aimed at the addressee
keep_features.rationale: The text uses a vulgar insult term as direct attack.

keep_features.feature_value: Mentions specific U.S. constitutional amendment numbers
keep_features.rationale: The amendment references act as dense named/legal entities.

keep_features.feature_value: Original criticizes following Trump; mirror retargets to the progressive squad/Sinema
keep_features.evidence_span: “following Trump off a cliff” vs “following the progressive squad off a cliff”
keep_features.rationale: The mirror changes the targeted blamed actor from Trump/Massie context to Sinema/progressive squad.

keep_features.feature_value: Implicates lack of acknowledgment as a driver of worsening outcomes
keep_features.evidence_span: “its only going to get worse” / “you cant even get the administration to recognize there is a problem”
keep_features.rationale: The statement links not acknowledging a problem to future worsening.

keep_features.feature_value: Frames trans people/people of faith as targeted for existing/believing
keep_features.evidence_span: “towards trans people for just existing” / “use their religion as an excuse to be cruel”
keep_features.rationale: The text characterizes a group as being harmed or attacked because of identity/religion.

keep_features.evidence_span: “The second amendment guarantees all the others”
keep_features.rationale: The content directly invokes the Second Amendment and firearm-related rights.

keep_features.feature_value: Accuses an actor of using a country as a tool for personal wants; parasite framing
keep_features.evidence_span: “Israel was just a tool to get what he wanted. He is a parasite on the world.”
keep_features.rationale: The post asserts a motive/causation claim and uses dehumanizing/derogatory language.

remove_features.rationale: A direct taboo word is used to attack the subject.

remove_features.feature_value: Short, emphatic imperative lines with aggressive capitalization
remove_features.evidence_span: “STRAIGHT TO JAIL.  RIGHT AWAY. NO TRIAL NO NOTHING.”
remove_features.rationale: Multiple emphatic bursts and compact slogans increase intensity.

remove_features.feature_value: Calls for immediate punishment without due process
remove_features.rationale: The text prescribes punishment and explicitly rejects procedural protections.
The phrase is capitalized like a headline/label and uses insulting gendered profanity.

remove_features.feature_value: Highly derogatory slur with censorship marks aimed at a commentator
remove_features.rationale: The text uses a strongly negative gendered insult.

remove_features.feature_value: Mocks the addressee as naive and reckless
remove_features.evidence_span: “Lmao you're such a clown” / “so naive and reckless”
remove_features.rationale: The communication uses insult and mockery rather than neutral disagreement.

remove_features.feature_value: Frames coastal elites/greens as ignoring urgent problems faced by others
remove_features.evidence_span: “Coastal elites are having meltdowns” / “actual problems like… become more and more prevalent.”
remove_features.rationale: The text contrasts an outgroup (elites/greens) with people facing practical issues.

remove_features.feature_value: Claims policy will raise costs, reduce jobs, overwhelm healthcare and housing
remove_features.evidence_span: “jobs will not be filled… Service will decline and cost will go up”
remove_features.rationale: The post uses cost/capacity impacts as the argument.
